originShared.text: TDLR's Air Conditioning and Refrigeration (ACR) Contractor reciprocity is limited to Georgia and South Carolina: the ACR002 application states Texas "currently reciprocates with Georgia and South Carolina only" (TDLR's ACR002 application). File the standard ACR002 contractor license application with the $115 non-refundable fee, including a copy of your current license and a list of the requirements you met to obtain it, as TDLR's out-of-state applicant page instructs. TDLR evaluates the out-of-state license case by case: depending on the requirements of your current license, you may be required to complete some or all of the Texas requirements for licensure, including taking a licensing examination.

Unless TDLR waives it, document at least 48 months (4 years) of practical experience within the preceding 72 months (6 years) on TDLR's Experience Verification Form, or substitute qualifying education for part of it per the form's education table.
Expect to schedule and pass the PSI-administered Texas exam for the applicable class (A or B) once TDLR approves the application; PSI's exam fee is not published in TDLR's materials.
Obtain the required certificate of insurance before the license is issued.
